changelog: Capture the Flag with team bases and defending bots in the new Candy Cup arena; more new arenas: Sugar Rush, Maple Street (modeled from a real surveyed neighborhood), and the Demolition District prototype; Rocket League-style air game with flip cancels, directional dodges, and surface-aware jumps, plus sharper power slides; all six cars rebuilt to reference proportions with the Scout now a true rally STI; closer combat camera; network protocol update - older clients will be prompted to update
